title: Architecture Preservation DNA v9B.2
description: Masterpiece OS Space Generator Phase 9B.2 Architecture-Preservation Calibration Input. v9B.2 是 Phase 9B.1 Reality Constraint layer 之后的 Architecture Preservation layer, 防止 Phase 9B.1 削弱 Architecture Anchor 提供的空间记忆点. 4 protected elements (ceiling_language / spatial_signature / material_expression / lighting_behavior) 都是机制级 (mechanism not object), 不添加具体装饰物. 不调真实 Provider, 不修改 Prompt Runtime (Phase 9B.2 §10 验收).

enabled.description: Phase 9B.2 §4 字段 1: 是否启用建筑保护层, 默认 true

weight.description: Phase 9B.2 §4 字段 2: 建筑语言保护权重. 0.3 弱保护 / 0.5 平衡 / 0.7 强保护 / 0.9 概念优先. JZMX 建议 0.7.

protectedElements.description: Phase 9B.2 §4 字段 3: 保护元素, 只保护机制不添加具体物体. 4 个合法值: ceiling_language / spatial_signature / material_expression / lighting_behavior

frozen_by: Space Generator v1.1 Phase 9B.2 Architecture-Preservation Calibration

layerBoundaryRules.SpatialIntentLayer_answer: 为什么需要这样的空间体验
layerBoundaryRules.ArchitectureBridgeLayer_answer: 什么建筑原则支持这种体验
layerBoundaryRules.SpatialRealityLayer_answer: 什么商业现实约束这个空间
layerBoundaryRules.ArchitecturePreservationLayer_answer: 什么建筑机制必须被保护 (mechanism not object)
ArchitecturePreservation_CAN: protect 4 mechanism types (ceiling_language / spatial_signature / material_expression / lighting_behavior)
preserve spatial structure / material relations / lighting logic from Architecture Anchor
ArchitecturePreservation_CANNOT: add specific decoration elements (装饰 / 雕塑 / 视觉符号)
copy specific reference image (e.g. 特定空间图片元素)
modify Architecture Anchor (Phase 8A) or architecture_context (Phase 8A) content
